name: r51_axis_pair_to_face_diagonal_angle_binding
description: Bind the two edge directions at Y to the two face-diagonal directions at W.
mechanism: Source Y is a genuine 90-degree corner on the back face: YZ and YX. Match short YZ/WX ray portions in red and YX/WZ in blue. This tests carrying orthogonality of two face axes to two face diagonals which share a positive depth component; treating W as90 makes all four90 and predicts D360. It does not mark a closed WXYZ polygon.
primary_math_proof: Exact current 3D points give X=Y=Z=90 and W=60; sum330, unique B. The shared depth component makes dot(WX,WZ)=1 rather than0. Four original arcs, all vertex positions and hidden edges remain intact.

difference_audit.old: red_quadrilateral highlighted all4 full sides in one red closed loop, presetD. Actual run1 B and run2 started then aborted, no complete pair; absent summary did not mean no calls.
difference_audit.new: Only four short rays, in two directional correspondence groups, at the separated Y and W corners. No full side, closed loop, extra arc or right-angle symbol.
difference_audit.substantive_difference: Transfer of orthogonality from same-face edge axes to adjacent-face diagonals; not coplanarity or planar polygon sum.
difference_audit.preset_rationale_before_calls: 90 atY transferred to actual60 atW makes90+90+90+90=360, D.

marker_roles.role: Y->Z source ray: back-face horizontal axis, red pair with W->X bottom-face diagonal.
W->X receiving ray: face diagonal with positive shared depth component, not a pure x axis.
Y->X source ray: vertical axis orthogonal to Y->Z in the same back face.
W->Z receiving ray: other face diagonal with the same positive depth component as W->X.

limits: Primary designer review only; parent must commission NEW independent review for any two-hit possibility.
Two model calls do not establish causal gain, population reliability or mechanism confirmation.
No original control is repeated; prior controls, if any, are retained as historical evidence.
